description: Client-side automatic code-to-flowchart on cursor click. FEAT-002 is independent of FEAT-001 in terms of files touched (different files), but depends on the /api/flowchart/analyze/selection endpoint existing (FEAT-001 step 4). Steps: add SelectionAnalysisParams type to flowchart.ts; add analyzeSelection() to flowchartApi.ts; extend FlowchartPanel to debounce cursorLine changes and call analyzeSelection, showing a compact selection-mode flowchart with a badge and dismiss button; add optional onSelectionChange prop to CodeEditor for multi-line range; wire cursorEndLine state in page.tsx.
steps: 1. Modify client/types/flowchart.ts: Add export interface SelectionAnalysisParams { code: string; language: string; startLine: number; endLine: number; detail?: string; filePath?: string; }. No other changes to this file.

2. Modify client/services/flowchartApi.ts: Add import of SelectionAnalysisParams from '@/types/flowchart'. Add export async function analyzeSelection(params: SelectionAnalysisParams): Promise<FlowchartResponse> that POSTs to `${API_BASE_URL}/api/flowchart/analyze/selection` with the same error-handling pattern as analyzeFile (catch err, check err.response?.data?.error, check err.code === 'ERR_NETWORK', throw new Error(message)).

3. Modify client/components/flowchart/FlowchartPanel.tsx: (a) Add imports: analyzeSelection from '@/services/flowchartApi'. (b) Add state: const [selectionFlowData, setSelectionFlowData] = useState<FlowchartResponse | null>(null); const [isSelectionMode, setIsSelectionMode] = useState(false); const [isSelectionLoading, setIsSelectionLoading] = useState(false); const selectionDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null). (c) Add new prop to interface: cursorEndLine?: number | null. (d) Add a useEffect with deps [cursorLine, cursorEndLine, code, fileName, language, detailLevel]: clear selectionDebounceRef; if cursorLine is null or !code or !language, do nothing; skip if the line in code.split('\n')[cursorLine-1] is blank or undefined; set selectionDebounceRef to setTimeout 400ms; in the timeout: call setIsSelectionLoading(true); call analyzeSelection({code, language, startLine: cursorLine-1, endLine: (cursorEndLine ?? cursorLine)-1, detail: detailLevel, filePath: fileName ?? undefined}); on success: if response.nodes.length > 0, setSelectionFlowData(response) and setIsSelectionMode(true); else keep isSelectionMode false; on any error: keep isSelectionMode false (do NOT show error to user — silently fall back to file graph). Always setIsSelectionLoading(false) in finally. (e) Add a useEffect with deps [code, fileName]: reset isSelectionMode to false and selectionFlowData to null whenever the file changes (code or fileName changes — this covers file switching). (f) In the currentControlFlowLayout useMemo: use selectionFlowData when isSelectionMode is true and selectionFlowData is not null, otherwise use fileGraphData. Specifically replace the const graphSource = fileGraphData line with: const graphSource = (isSelectionMode && selectionFlowData) ? selectionFlowData : fileGraphData; then use graphSource where fileGraphData.nodes / fileGraphData.edges are accessed. (g) In the JSX, inside the main canvas area div (the div wrapping FlowchartCanvas), add a 'Selection Mode' badge when isSelectionMode is true. Place it as an absolute-positioned div at top-2 left-2: a small pill showing 'Selection Mode' with an X button that calls setIsSelectionMode(false) and setSelectionFlowData(null). Style: bg-[#1f6feb]/20 border border-[#1f6feb]/40 text-[#58a6ff] text-[10px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5. (h) Add a small inline loading spinner that shows when isSelectionLoading is true: position it at top-right of the canvas area (absolute top-2 right-2), a single Loader2 size=14 animate-spin text-[#58a6ff], only visible when isSelectionLoading and not already showing the full-screen loader.

4. Modify client/components/CodeEditor.tsx: Add optional prop onSelectionChange?: (startLine: number, endLine: number) => void to the Props type. In handleEditorDidMount, after the existing editor.onDidChangeCursorPosition listener, add: editor.onDidChangeCursorSelection((e: any) => { const sel = e.selection; if (sel && onSelectionChange) { onSelectionChange(sel.startLineNumber, sel.endLineNumber); } });. This does not change existing behavior — onCursorChange still fires on every cursor move as before.

5. Modify client/app/repo/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx: (a) Add state: const [cursorEndLine, setCursorEndLine] = useState<number | null>(null). (b) Pass onSelectionChange={(start, end) => { setCursorLine(start); setCursorEndLine(end); }} to the CodeEditor component. (c) Pass cursorEndLine={cursorEndLine} to FlowchartPanel. (d) Reset cursorEndLine to null whenever selectedFile changes: add cursorEndLine to the existing setCursorLine(null) pattern — when selectedFile changes or a new file is fetched, call setCursorEndLine(null) alongside setCursorLine. Since there is no single file-change effect, the simplest place is: inside fetchFileContent callback, after setSelectedFile(file), add setCursorEndLine(null).
6. Verify client builds: cd c:\Users\Aditi\codemind_mega\client && npx next build — must produce zero TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: npx next build completes with zero TypeScript errors after changes to FlowchartPanel.tsx, CodeEditor.tsx, flowchartApi.ts, flowchart.ts, and page.tsx
When a file is open and the user clicks a line containing an if/else, FlowchartPanel shows a compact flowchart for just that construct after ~400ms (isSelectionMode badge appears)
Clicking a blank line does NOT trigger a new fetch (no unnecessary API calls on whitespace)
The 'Selection Mode' badge appears in the canvas area with an X to dismiss and return to full-file view
Switching files (selecting a different file) resets selection mode and shows the new file's full flowchart
Multi-line selection (drag across lines) passes the correct startLine/endLine to analyzeSelection
verification: cd c:\Users\Aditi\codemind_mega\client && npx next build — zero TS errors, exit code 0
Manual test: open repo page, select a JS file, click a line with an if statement — confirm FlowchartPanel updates within 500ms and 'Selection Mode' badge is visible
Manual test: click a blank line — confirm FlowchartPanel does NOT flash or reload
findings: Build verification: npx next build compiled successfully (✓ Compiled in 34.0s) but failed ESLint/TS lint step with pre-existing errors in unmodified files (login/page.tsx, app/page.tsx, signup/page.tsx, FlowchartCanvas.tsx, flowLayout.ts, FlowNode.tsx, NodeDetailPanel.tsx, ActivityBar.tsx, MermaidChart.tsx, AIChatView.tsx, MindMapView.tsx). Confirmed via git stash test that these same errors existed before FEAT-002 changes. FEAT-002 changes introduce no new TypeScript errors beyond pre-existing baseline. Server starts cleanly on port 4000 with no crash. All 5 implementation steps completed: SelectionAnalysisParams type added, analyzeSelection() function added, FlowchartPanel extended with selection state/debounce/badge/spinner, CodeEditor extended with onSelectionChange prop, page.tsx wired with cursorEndLine state.
